import workcell, sys, time
jar='J2'; tare=119.62; target=250.0; lo=249.80; hi=250.20

def call(tool,*args):
    r=workcell.call(tool,*args,timeout=600)
    if not r.ok:
        print('ERR', tool, args, r.text)
        sys.exit(1)
    return r

def get_net():
    r=call('scale','read')
    return r.data['gross_g'] - tare

r=call('robot','pick',jar); print(r.text)
r=call('robot','place','platform'); print(r.text)
n=get_net(); print('start_net %.2f'%n)

for i in range(4):
    call('robot','dose','bulk')
n=get_net(); print('after_4bulk %.2f'%n)

# Coarse until at least 238 g net
coarse=0
while n < 238.0:
    call('robot','dose','coarse')
    n=get_net(); coarse+=1
    if coarse>20: print('too many coarse'); sys.exit(1)
print('after_coarse %.2f (%d doses)'%(n,coarse))

# Fine until at least 246 g net (safe even with a lump up to ~3g)
fine=0
while n < 246.0:
    call('robot','dose','fine')
    n=get_net(); fine+=1
    if fine>50: print('too many fine'); sys.exit(1)
print('after_fine %.2f (%d doses)'%(n,fine))

# Micro to final window, but avoid a micro that could overshoot: dose while net < 249.65
micro=0
while n < 249.65:
    call('robot','dose','micro')
    n=get_net(); micro+=1
    if micro>200: print('too many micro'); sys.exit(1)
print('after_micro %.2f (%d doses)'%(n,micro))

# If still below lower bound, one more micro likely gets into band; if above hi, handle
if n < lo:
    call('robot','dose','micro')
    n=get_net(); micro+=1
    print('extra_micro %.2f'%n)

print('final_net %.2f'%n)
if lo <= n <= hi:
    r=call('checkweigher','check'); print(r.text)
    r=call('robot','pick',jar); print(r.text)
    r=call('robot','place','rack'); print(r.text)
else:
    print('MISSED WINDOW', n)
    sys.exit(1)
